tonight.headline: Up 27.2 with Los Cachanillas finished — Golden and Pickens are playing, Daniels on Monday
body: Bad news first: George Pickens has 2.6 tonight — healthy, just not targeted early (Yahoo 19 Oct 00:57Z) — and Rashee Rice was inactive for a second week. Garrett Wilson finished 8.4.

Nothing to do. Los Cachanillas are final at 88.62; you lead by 27.2 with Golden (17.1) and Pickens still playing and Daniels on Monday. ESPN: 99%. At 0-5, this is the first win of the season in all but name.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every bench player has played or cannot: Stroud and Worthy are final, Jacobs is inactive (SI 18 Oct), Gordon is on bye, Rice is out. No starter can be replaced.

case.label: Daniels
case.body: Full practices and no designation (SI Commanders final report 17 Oct). Washington's inactives come Monday 16:45 CDMX; a scratch could not be covered, and the lead would still hold.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing realistic: Los Cachanillas have no player left.

case.label: The bye
case.body: Washington (Daniels) and Jacksonville (Tuten) are on bye in Week 7 (ESPN file); Houston's is Week 8. Stroud was added on 17 Oct as this cover and threw three touchdowns in London today (archive, 23.0).

case.label: The running back
case.body: Tuten's Jacksonville bye: Josh Jacobs comes off the exempt list Monday and is expected to return immediately as Green Bay's starter in Week 7 at Detroit (SI 18 Oct, citing Pelissero and Schefter); the league reserves the right to add discipline. Gordon is Miami's clear lead back after their bye (Yardbarker 18 Oct). Tuesday's projection picks between them.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero; this is a forced move, and it waits until Daniels has played Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Stroud is ruled out for Week 7, or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: On waivers until Wednesday 01:00 CDMX — and Bam Knight out-gained him today.

case.label: The player
case.body: 18 carries and 2 targets for 5.8 in Arizona's 18-16 win; Knight 15 carries for 80 (NBC Sports 19 Oct 00:33Z; live archive). Love OUT with the ankle, no IR plan (4for4 16 Oct).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: IPADE priority never resets, and a back who lost the efficient half of a split to his backup is a patch, not a starter. Jacobs is expected to start for Green Bay in Week 7 (SI 18 Oct) and covers Tuten's bye with Gordon.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Love goes on IR and Knight's possible injury keeps him out — then Allgeier is the only back left, and the claim is Tuesday night's question, before 01:00 Wednesday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier goes unclaimed and scores over 15 a game in Weeks 7-8 while Bloodsports' backs fall short.
